extension.summary: EPGStation の録画を閲覧・再生
extension.description: Lists recordings from an EPGStation 2.x server with full EPG information (description, extended info, genres, channel, broadcast time) and plays them directly.
EPGStation 2.x サーバーの録画を番組情報（概要・詳細・ジャンル・放送局・放送日時）付きで一覧表示し、直接再生します。
extension.news: v0.3.1 (2026-10-14) - 変換して再生 / Stream transcoded: play a recording transcoded by EPGStation (e.g. 720p / 480p) for weak clients; start from the beginning, a saved position or a chosen time; seeking within the transcoded part with inputstream.adaptive - New 変換再生 settings: transcode mode (server's first or last mode, or ask each time) - The stream is always stopped on the server when playback ends; a listing left by a killed Kodi is cleaned up on the next transcoded start

extension.summary: KODIstation のインストールと自動更新
extension.description: Kodi repository for KODIstation, the EPGStation 2.x add-on. Install KODIstation from here and Kodi keeps it up to date with every release.
EPGStation 2.x 用アドオン KODIstation のリポジトリです。ここから KODIstation をインストールすると、リリースごとに Kodi が自動で更新します。
